facts.fact: Erribat.info reports that the Minister of Youth Empowerment, Employment, Sports and Civil Service launched Mourchid, a government AI assistant working in Arabic and French that answers on jobs, civil service, youth and sports programmes from ministry databases and official documents, with voice search, around the clock.

systems.owner: Ministry of Youth Empowerment, Employment, Sports and Civil Service

MRT.note: Mourchid answers information queries and gives no diagnosis, score or decision.
The document does not say who built Mourchid or its model.
